# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] <project-slug>: <Short Project Title>`
>
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/<project-slug>/`
>
> **Mandatory Next Step:** After opening this PR, submit the PR URL through the official Google Form: **[GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_BE_ADDED]**.

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** Db2 Runbook Assistant
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/db2-runbook-assistant/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** A RAG assistant that answers IT support questions from internal runbooks. Runbooks are embedded and stored in IBM Db2 as vectors, and a local IBM Granite model writes the answer from the closest runbook text.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** IT support and operations engineers lose time searching long runbooks during incidents, and keyword search misses answers when the wording differs. The assistant finds the right runbook by meaning and answers from it.

---

---

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** Db2 Community Edition 12.1.2.0 on Docker (`icr.io/db2_community/db2:12.1.2.0`)
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** Db2 is the vector store. Runbook text, metadata and embeddings are stored in a Db2 `VECTOR` column, and questions are answered with Db2 vector similarity search (cosine distance).
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** `ibm-db-haystack` (official Haystack IBM Db2 integration: `IBMDb2DocumentStore` and `IBMDb2EmbeddingRetriever`)
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** Database `RUNBOOKS`. One document-store table holding runbook chunks, metadata and embedding vectors. Data: 8 sample IT runbooks in `src/data/runbooks`.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:** Start Db2 with Docker (`docker compose --env-file ../.env up -d` from `src/`), run `python ingest.py`, then open the table in Db2 (for example with the IBM Db2 Developer Extension in VS Code) and check that it contains the runbook chunks. Run `python ask.py` to see answers built from Db2 search results. Full steps are in the README.

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** Haystack, ibm-db-haystack, Docker Compose
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** Haystack
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** Ollama (local). Embeddings: `granite-embedding:278m`. Answers: `granite3.3:8b`.
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:** The embedding model converts runbooks and questions into vectors. After Db2 returns the closest runbook text, the Granite model writes a grounded answer from it.

---

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

Please verify and check every item before requesting review:

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/<project-slug>/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `<project-slug>` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/<project-slug>/README.md` and `submissions/<project-slug>/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/<project-slug>/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [ ] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers.
- [ ] **License Declared:** Open-source license or distribution terms are specified.
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository [Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/<project-slug>/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form (**[GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_BE_ADDED]**).

---

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

- All models run locally through Ollama, so no cloud account or API key is needed.
- `docker-compose.yml` reads the Db2 password from `.env` (`${DB2_PASSWORD}`), so no password is stored in the repository.
- Screenshots will be added to `docs/screenshots/` in a follow-up commit to this PR.
